description: This file defines synchronization utilities for API locking, including thread-local flags, lock management templates, and guard classes for safe lock handling in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: ApiLocks
classes.description: Keeps API locks, one per specific class, using static recursive_mutex.

classes.name: UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: Guard that unlocks the API mutex if the thread is using a locked API, and re-locks upon destruction.

classes.name: LockApiGuard
classes.description: Guard that manages locking and unlocking of the API mutex using std::unique_lock.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Creates a function wrapper that locks the API mutex, calls the specified method, and manages thread-local flags.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers a method with the JSONRPC system, wrapping it with locking logic.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers a method with version support, with locking.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers a method with a JSONRPC handler, with locking.
